observed_defect.summary: The frozen classifier consistently recognized the semantic class but displaced it among destination_scope, domain, and capability; the deterministic Python detector also treated ordinary instructions beginning with 'return' as source code.
bounded_evidence: 10/10 civics rows emitted semantic domain=civics but were rejected because destination_scope was english_core.
10/10 mathematics rows emitted semantic domain=mathematics but were rejected because destination_scope was english_core.
10/10 English rows emitted semantic destination_scope=english_core but frequently placed the requested capability in domain or used none/quarantine there.
A Python false positive was caused by the pattern matching ordinary phrases such as 'Return only one JSON object'.
All 10 quarantine rows remained quarantined and no non-English row entered English core.

single_correction.name: schema-normalized corroboration and Python false-positive repair
rules: Remove the generic 'return <word>' Python pattern; retain explicit Python, fenced Python, def, and import signals.

For exactly one deterministic known-domain signal, accept only when the semantic classifier's domain field independently equals that domain at medium or high confidence; canonicalize destination and capability from the locked ontology.

For no deterministic domain or quarantine signal, accept English only when the semantic classifier independently emits destination_scope=english_core at medium or high confidence and the prompt has exactly one locked task-semantic capability signal; canonicalize domain=domain_independent.

Any forced quarantine, malformed output, low confidence, absent capability signal, conflicting capability signals, absent domain corroboration, unknown domain, label spoof, or multiple domain remains quarantine.
prohibited_changes: No benchmark row, gold label, split, threshold, ontology, or source artifact may change.
No validation observation may be inspected before implementation freeze.
No second code correction is permitted after this amendment.
LayerCake may not be invoked and no training artifact may be composed.

next_steps: Implement and unit-test only this correction.
Replay the disclosed calibration partition into a new immutable evidence file.
Execute the untouched validation partition exactly once.
